core_principles: Tactical Depth over Generic AI Slop: Ditch cheap centered cards, fuzzy full-screen cyan-purple gradients, and random floating rounded pills. Use structured 1px hairlines, subtle depth tiers, and crisp optical alignments.
Theme Token Fidelity: Always bind accent highlights to launcher CSS custom properties (--brand, --brand-glow, --brand-subtle, --page-elevated) so user-selected themes render perfectly.
Micro-Tactile Precision: Every action bar, reaction chip, and attachment badge responds with tight spring curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and crisp state feedback.
Minecraft & Gaming Heritage with High-End SaaS Sophistication: High-definition 3D face avatars, subtle grid textures, and clean JetBrains Mono metadata paired with Figtree headers.

surface_elevation_and_depth.tier_0_canvas: var(--page) - Lowest depth layer behind the messenger layout
surface_elevation_and_depth.tier_2_conversation: var(--page-sunken) or subtle 0.5px dotted dark grid background
surface_elevation_and_depth.tier_3_glass_header: var(--surface-glass-strong) with backdrop-filter: blur(16px) and 1px bottom border
surface_elevation_and_depth.tier_4_floating_bars_and_popovers: var(--component-bg) with var(--shadow-popover) and crisp 1px border var(--hairline-strong)

grid_and_layout.overall_container: Full viewport fixed grid inside Electron window (height: 100vh, width: 100%)
grid_and_layout.columns: 280px fixed left inbox rail + flex: 1 main conversation panel
grid_and_layout.responsive_min_max: Desktop width 1100px to 2560px. Sidebar flexes down to 260px on narrower viewports if needed.

inbox_rail.header: Title 'Noctra Relay' with animated live status pulse dot + action button for 'New Group'
inbox_rail.search_bar: Integrated dark search box with shortcut hint [Ctrl+K], search icon, clean focus ring using var(--brand)
inbox_rail.sections: PINNED, GROUPS, DIRECT MESSAGES with collapsible chevron, count counter, subtle letter-spacing

thread_row.layout: Flex container with 36px 3D Minecraft skin avatar, status indicator overlay at bottom-right
thread_row.states: Default (transparent bg), Hover (var(--component-bg-hover)), Active/Selected (var(--brand-subtle) with 2px solid left accent indicator)
thread_row.content: Top row: Thread name + timestamp (var(--fg-muted)). Bottom row: Snippet with delivery status icons (check / double check) + typing animation or unread counter badge

conversation_header.avatar_and_title: 40px avatar with presence dot, peer username in 15px/700, activity status string ('In-game: hypixel.net' in success green or 'In Launcher')
conversation_header.action_toolbar: Search message button, Quick 'Join Server' button (solid or subtle brand style when peer is in game), Pin toggle, Group settings, Overflow dropdown
conversation_header.surface: Fixed top bar (56px) with backdrop-filter blur(16px) and hairline bottom stroke

message_stream.day_divider: Centered pill with date string, flanked by subtle horizontal hairline rules
message_stream.incoming_bubble: Left-aligned, dark elevated surface (var(--component-bg)), 12px padding, radius 12px (top-left 3px for tail accent)
message_stream.outgoing_bubble: Right-aligned, tinted brand background (var(--brand-subtle)), 1px brand border, white text, radius 12px (top-right 3px for tail accent)
message_stream.system_message: Centered subtle card with icon for group events (joins, avatar changes, pins)
message_stream.group_authors: Display 12px bold colored username above incoming message in group chats

rich_media_cards.images: Image card with rounded corners, overlay gradient on hover, progress indicator during upload, click-to-open lightbox
rich_media_cards.voice_notes: Audio waveform visualizer bar + play/pause toggle + timestamp duration badge
rich_media_cards.file_attachments: File type icon + name + size + download trigger card

message_stream.reaction_badges: Mini pill badges below message with emoji + count, active state has primary brand border and subtle fill
message_stream.hover_action_bar: Floating micro toolbar (Reply, React, Edit, Delete, Pin) with backdrop-blur, appearing on message row hover with spring scale transition

composer.wrapper: Subtle card surface anchored at bottom, top border var(--hairline), rounded-xl inset border on focus
composer.previews: Attachment thumbnail preview list with removal buttons + Reply-to context banner with close button
composer.input_row: Auto-resizing text field, Attachment button, GIF picker toggle, Emoji picker toggle, Voice note mic toggle, Send button (brand solid gradient)
composer.drag_drop_overlay: Smooth full-pane drop area with dashed brand border, floating upload icon, and blurred backdrop when dragging files over messenger

modals_and_popovers.popovers: GIF picker / Emoji picker with custom scrollbars, tabbed navigation, search input, elevation 4 shadow
modals_and_popovers.lightbox: Full screen overlay backdrop with zoom/download buttons and high-res image view

specs: Staggered entrance for thread rows on load (delay: index * 25ms, opacity 0->1, translateY 6px->0px)
Message send feedback: Outgoing bubble scales up from 0.96 with spring easing
Hover action bar: Scale 0.92 to 1.0, fade in over 120ms when hovering message container
Full compliance with data-motion='reduced' attribute (force 1ms transitions and no transforms)

empty_loading_error_states.empty_conversation: Tactical centered layout with subtle vector icon, 'No message selected' label in var(--fg-muted), and quick 'Start Chat' trigger button
empty_loading_error_states.skeleton_loading: Shimmer animation over threat rows and message bubbles using CSS linear-gradient animation with var(--component-bg-hover)
empty_loading_error_states.error_banner: Subtle top banner with danger red tint, retry action button, and clear message failed indicator

dated_ai_slop_anti_patterns_to_replace: REPLACE: Heavy full-screen cyan-to-purple diagonal gradients with clean, dark architectural surfaces that respects theme tokens.
REPLACE: High-radius pill shape wrappers around entire panels with crisp 1px bordered containers and contextual inner radii.
REPLACE: Plain browser scrollbars with custom 4px dark scrollbar tracks and rounded thumbs.
REPLACE: Static uninteresting message lists with smooth staggered loading, subtle message grouping, and crisp delivery tick states.
instructions_to_main_agent: Update `RelayPage.css` and `relay-groups.css` directly to apply the new local CSS variables and refined design specs.
Do NOT hardcode colors; use `var(--brand)`, `var(--page)`, `var(--component-bg)`, and the newly added `--relay-*` CSS variables.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, thread rows, action bars).
Ensure the layout stays responsive between 1100px and 2560px within the Electron client.
Test hover, active, unread, and typing states across direct messages and group chats.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.dark_theme_rule: Dark colors look best when used as solid/subtle glass surfaces rather than heavy bright gradients.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.alignment: Never center-align message body text; left-align content for natural reading flow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. Never use raw emoji characters as functional icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testability: Ensure data-testid attributes are kebab-case and descriptive for every key control.
